name: 工作流与后台任务
description: 持久化 DAG、恢复复用、并发控制和后台命令。

features.name: DAG、声明式 DSL 与模型编排
features.nameEn: DAG, declarative DSL and model orchestration

features.name: 只读及已批准可写 actor 与问答
features.nameEn: Read-only and approved writable actors and questions

features.name: 持久恢复、结果复用与文件校验
features.nameEn: Persistent resume, result reuse and file checks

features.name: 动态并发、限流退避与跨运行调度
features.nameEn: Adaptive concurrency, rate backoff and scheduling

features.name: 后台命令、日志、状态与取消
features.nameEn: Background commands, logs, status and cancellation

features.name: 专家工作流（调研、计划、实现、审查）
按会话列出、取消与恢复动态工作流运行
features.nameEn: Per-session dynamic workflow run listing, cancellation and resume

features.name: 已保存工作流模板库（保存、列出、按名运行）
features.nameEn: Saved workflow template library (save, list, run by name)

features.name: 原生类型脚本、动态分支与并行
features.nameEn: Native typed scripts, dynamic branches and fan-out

features.name: 节点日志恢复、结果重用与修订
features.nameEn: Journaled script resume, result reuse and amendment

features.name: 脚本留白与 actor 问答恢复
features.nameEn: Script holes and actor question recovery
